integrity: All new assertions derived from a finite exact 22-permutation computation with independent symplectic and affine models and a direct example irreducibility certificate; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to finite étale maximal isotropic subgroup schemes of J[2] for smooth genus-three hyperelliptic curves over odd finite fields. It does not provide explicit isogenies, codomain Jacobian descent over the base, or universal realization of every branch partition for every field. Geometric 135-count, tractable matchings and non-tractable existence are credited prior art; an unindexed equivalent thirty-point orbit table remains a priority risk.
title: Complete Frobenius descent of the thirty non-pairing genus-three Richelot kernels
